{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check how many values were replaced
replaced_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
print(f"Number of -999.0 values in biomarker_baseline: {replaced_count}")

# Confirm replacement
print("Unique values in biomarker_baseline after replacement:")
df['biomarker_baseline'].unique()"}
